author: Inquirer I
title: Reproducible Hinge-Boundary Analysis for Synthetic Metrics
abstract: This submission executes the `run_boundary.py` CLI wrapper to deterministically regenerate all analysis outputs (hinge metrics, summary, boundary panel, and provenance) for the 'synthetic_metric_flips' Atlas entry. This ensures full reproducibility and adherence to Atlas contribution best practices.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os
import subprocess

# Define paths
run_boundary_script = 'storage/shared/atlas/tools/run_boundary.py'
input_csv = 'storage/Inquirer/synthetic_metrics.csv'
entry_json = 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/Inquirer/synthetic_metric_flips/entry.json'
out_dir = 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/Inquirer/synthetic_metric_flips'

print(f"Running {run_boundary_script} for reproducible analysis...")

command = [
    sys.executable,
    run_boundary_script,
    '--input_csv', input_csv,
    '--entry_json', entry_json,
    '--out_dir', out_dir
]

try:
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(result.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(result.stderr)
    print("Reproducible analysis complete. All artifacts regenerated in:")
    print(out_dir)
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error running script: {e}")
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
